tokens.notes: prominent capsule pills are black, NOT system accent — brand signature, non-native
only saturated brand hue; confined to the app-icon 'D' glyph, absent from UI chrome
'N saves' counts + deselected tabs — clean de-emphasis
steps down from card radius → roughly concentric

marketing side; large, tight-tracked, black weight

patterns.key_values: Pinterest-style masonry of image thumbnails; upper band = small elevated white 'collection' cards with two-line caption (bold title + grey N-saves), lower band = larger full-bleed variable-height image cards; content is the hero, colour comes entirely from user artwork
near-white #FAFAFA header, no hard bottom divider; leading = app-icon + 'Library' pop-up switcher, trailing = search glyph only; one black capsule pill as sole prominent action

scope nav = underline tabs (All active w/ short black underline · Unsorted · Trash) — non-native scope switch; 'Library ⌄' double-chevron pop-up is the one native-grammar-correct affordance (pick-a-value)

signature_moves: Colourless chrome as a gallery wall: entire UI is black/white/#FAFAFA/grey with ZERO accent tint in the chrome, so the saved (saturated) design thumbnails carry 100% of the screen's colour — reverse Von Restorff, the frame recedes so content pops
Black capsule = the one brand action, echoed identically from marketing ('Download for Mac') to product ('Library' pill) — a single consistent high-contrast action shape
defects: Non-native scope switch — underline tabs (All/Unsorted/Trash) instead of a segmented control or source-list sidebar
Accent not bound to system — prominent action is a hardcoded black pill, not the user's system accent
Faux/colourless chrome — three monochrome grey window dots instead of genuine coloured traffic lights (possibly a deliberate inactive-window marketing render — noted, not asserted)

aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product taken to a monochrome-gallery extreme — near-white surface, heavy geometric-grotesque brand type, black-and-white chrome, saturation delegated entirely to user content (design-craft: 'Restrained' colour strategy pushed to its limit; chrome is jewelry-free so the collection is the palette)

psychology: Von Restorff (reverse) — colourless chrome means the single black pill and the saturated content thumbnails are the only things that stand out; the frame deliberately never competes
Aesthetic-Usability Effect — crisp white gallery + polished brand type buys a trust halo on first contact (fitting for a taste-signalling design tool)
Law of Proximity / Common Region — collection cards use white-card enclosure + tight caption proximity to bind thumbnail and label into one unit
Jakob's Law — the masonry card grid mimics Pinterest/Eagle conventions the target designer audience already knows; conventional for the genre
Hierarchy via de-emphasis — bold card title over grey 'N saves' is textbook label/value de-emphasis
notes: SINGLE ASSET, MARKETING COVER ONLY: a 1200x630 OG composite, no clean app screenshots supplied. The app window is 3D-perspective-transformed, so NO reliable pixel measurements are possible — all spatial/type tokens are (estimated) with wide ranges. Left half = brand evidence (wordmark, headline, CTA); right half = the app window; analysed separately, never conflated. Lineage is non-native (web-electron, low confidence — could be bespoke SwiftUI going custom); either way it feeds NO macOS canon. meta.json has no long_description, only tagline 'The Mac app for design inspiration'. Value to corpus = the gallery-white content-forward AESTHETIC pattern, not any native token. A clean @2x light+dark screenshot would materially raise lineage confidence and unlock real measurements.
